'you who rule alone' (6:9, 6:21) / 'absolute rulers' (8:15), never 'tyrants', which in English means cruel rulers; a note at 6:9. Added by Wis 06-10.
παιδεία / παιδεύω, of teaching (Wisdom of Solomon 6:11, 17–18, 25; 7:14)

instruction / teach, instruct, where the sense is education; 'discipline' (the existing Wisdom entry) stays for God's correction (3:5; 11:9; 12:22). Why: in chapters 6–7 the word is a learner's training, and English 'discipline' would read as punishment. Note at 6:17. Added by Wis 06-10.
